svg.text: CLOUD DEPLOYMENT TCO SELECTION: SERVERLESS PAYGO VS. PROVISIONED PTU/GSU VS. SELF-HOSTED K8S
3-Zone Crossover Matrix (35% PTU Util & 2.5B Tok/Mo Self-Host Break-Even) Cuts TCO 71.7%
15B Tokens/Mo Enterprise Platform: Tier 1 Pure PAYGO ($360K/mo) vs. Tier 3 Pure PTU ($207K/mo) vs. Tier 4 Hybrid ($102K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1 & 2 Traps: Wrong Mode for Traffic Scale
1. Trap A: Premature Self-Hosting Below `1.5B–2.5B Tokens/Mo`:
• Self-hosting K8s (`AKS/GKE + vLLM`) carries `~$22K/mo` fixed SRE
labor + multi-AZ idle GPUs—making `<500M tok/mo` cost `$4.85/1M`!
2. Trap B: Staying on Pure `PAYGO` Above `35%` Average Utilization:
• At `15B tokens/mo`, linear PAYGO billing hits `$360,000/mo` and
suffers `1,480ms` P99 TTFT from shared multi-tenant throttling
3. Trap C: Buying 100%-Peak `PTU` for Spiky Daytime Traffic:
• 58% of committed PTUs sit idle at night without PAYGO spillover
Single-Mode Deployment Failure Impact (15B Tokens/Mo):
• Tier 1 Pure PAYGO: $360K/mo ($2.40/1M), 1,480ms P99 TTFT
• Tier 2 Premature Small Self-Host: $4.85/1M effective token cost
• Tier 3 100%-Peak PTU: $207K/mo (58% night-time idle waste)
🏆 Tier 4: The 3-Zone TCO Crossover Architecture
1. Zone 1 (`<1B Tok/Mo` or `<35% Util`): `Serverless MaaS PAYGO`
• Zero fixed floor, instant multi-model access, pay per token
2. Zone 2 (`>=35% Util` Proprietary Model): `P80 PTU/GSU + P20 PAYGO`
• Break-even at `35%` util (or `22%` with Prefix Cache discount!)
3. Zone 3 (`>=2.5B Tok/Mo` Open-Weights): `Self-Hosted K8s (vLLM/SGLang)`
• Offloads 70% high-volume tasks to self-hosted `FP8` open-weights
on `AKS/GKE + KAITO`, keeping 30% frontier calls on `PTU + PAYGO`
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (15B Tokens/Mo):
• Effective Blended Cost: $0.68 / 1M Tokens (-71.7% vs. PAYGO)
• P99 TTFT: 420 ms | Platform Availability: 99.95%
• Monthly Total Platform TCO: $102,000 / mo (Saves $258K/mo!)
